assumptions: Every reaction gets the same recipe; the overage covers pipetting loss and is a percent of the N-reaction mix.
limits: Does not check that a custom recipe's concentrations suit the polymerase: only the vendor setups carry final concentrations.
A vendor setup is cached from the vendor's document on the date it records; a reformulated product is not seen until the cache is refreshed.
bio.jane/contract.question: How much of each reagent goes into a master mix for this many reactions?

description: Scale one PCR reaction into a master mix for N reactions plus overage. Starts from a vendor's own published reaction setup (scaled to any reaction volume in proportion to the vendor's columns, so every final concentration is the vendor's, with water making up the volume and the template added per tube), or from your own component list. Returns each component per reaction and in the mix, the mix to dispense per tube and the total to prepare.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

components.description: your own recipe instead of a vendor setup: objects of { name, perReaction (µl), fill (true on the one component that makes up the volume), perTube (true to add it to each tube instead of the mix) }. Advanced.

include_dmso.description: include the setup's optional DMSO (3% final). Offered by Phusion High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (M0530); the setup's notes say when to use it. Only applies when setup is neb-phusion-m0530.

include_q_solution.description: include the setup's optional Q-Solution (1x (from the 5x stock) final). Offered by QIAGEN Taq DNA Polymerase (201203), QIAGEN HotStarTaq DNA Polymerase (203203); the setup's notes say when to use it. Only applies when setup is qiagen-taq-201203 or qiagen-hotstartaq-203203.

mg_final.description: total Mg²⁺ in the reaction, mM, reached by adding the vendor's 25 mM MgCl2 on top of what the buffer holds. Unset uses the vendor's default. Offered by QIAGEN Taq DNA Polymerase (201203), QIAGEN HotStarTaq DNA Polymerase (203203). In mM. Only applies when setup is qiagen-taq-201203 or qiagen-hotstartaq-203203.

overage.description: extra mix for pipetting loss, as a percent of the N-reaction volume. In %.

primer_final.description: final concentration of each primer, µM. Most vendors state primers as a range rather than a volume; unset uses the setup's own value (its single stated value, else the low end of its range). In µM. Only applies when setup is takara-taq-r001a or takara-ex-taq-rr001a or takara-la-taq-rr002a or takara-ex-premier-rr370a or primestar-gxl-r050a or primestar-gxl-r050a-rapid or primestar-hs-r010a or primestar-max-r045a or primestar-longseq-r055a or cloneamp-hifi-639298 or speedstar-hs-rr070a or terra-direct-639270 or advantage-hd-639241 or qiagen-taq-201203 or qiagen-hotstartaq-203203.

primer_stock.description: concentration of your primer stock, µM; each primer's volume is its final concentration diluted from this stock. In µM. Only applies when setup is takara-taq-r001a or takara-ex-taq-rr001a or takara-la-taq-rr002a or takara-ex-premier-rr370a or primestar-gxl-r050a or primestar-gxl-r050a-rapid or primestar-hs-r010a or primestar-max-r045a or primestar-longseq-r055a or cloneamp-hifi-639298 or speedstar-hs-rr070a or terra-direct-639270 or advantage-hd-639241 or qiagen-taq-201203 or qiagen-hotstartaq-203203.

reaction_volume.description: volume of one reaction, µl. Each vendor publishes its setup at one or two volumes (25, 50 or 100 µl; NEB's Phusion at 20 and 50); any volume scales from them. In µl.

reactions.description: how many reactions the mix is for.

setup.description: the vendor reaction setup to scale. Ignored when `components` is given. Values: neb-phusion-m0530 (Phusion High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (M0530)), takara-taq-r001a (TaKaRa Taq (R001A)), takara-ex-taq-rr001a (TaKaRa Ex Taq (RR001A)), takara-la-taq-rr002a (TaKaRa LA Taq (RR002A)), takara-ex-premier-rr370a (TaKaRa Ex Premier (RR370A)), primestar-gxl-r050a (PrimeSTAR GXL (R050A), standard protocol), primestar-gxl-r050a-rapid (PrimeSTAR GXL (R050A), rapid protocol), primestar-hs-r010a (PrimeSTAR HS (R010A)), primestar-max-r045a (PrimeSTAR Max (R045A)), primestar-longseq-r055a (PrimeSTAR LongSeq (R055S/R055A)), cloneamp-hifi-639298 (CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix (639298)), speedstar-hs-rr070a (SpeedSTAR HS (RR070A)), terra-direct-639270 (Terra PCR Direct Polymerase Mix (639270)), titanium-taq-639208 (Titanium Taq DNA Polymerase (639208)), advantage-hd-639241 (Advantage HD Polymerase Mix (639241)), qiagen-taq-201203 (QIAGEN Taq DNA Polymerase (201203)), qiagen-hotstartaq-203203 (QIAGEN HotStarTaq DNA Polymerase (203203)). Only applies when components is not given.

template_volume.description: template DNA per reaction, µl, added to each tube rather than the mix. The vendor states an amount, not a volume (NEB Phusion: < 250 ng), so the volume is yours. In µl. Only applies when components is not given.

name: plan_master_mix

dispensePerTube.description: µl of master mix to dispense into each tube

mixTotal.description: µl of master mix to prepare

rows.description: each component: name, µl per reaction, µl in the mix (null when added per tube)
